name: Zapier Central
pros: Standing agents over a vast integration network
value: Persistent AI agents that watch for conditions in connected apps and take actions when those conditions are met. Where Zapier AI is a step in a Zap, Central is a standing agent with memory and multi-step reasoning.
engine: Routes to frontier models via Zapier's infrastructure over the same app network.
latency: Async. Agents run on a schedule or on trigger.
quality: As an agentic product, output quality depends on prompt quality and how well edge cases are handled in the agent's instructions.
tagline: Zapier's agent layer: bots that observe and act across your connected apps.
use_cases: Monitoring inboxes, CRMs, and ticketing systems and acting when conditions are met
Cross-app workflows that require conditional logic beyond simple if-this-then-that
Delegating recurring multi-step operational tasks to a managed agent
governance_note: An agent that runs autonomously across your business data is a materially different risk profile from a one-shot automation. Two controls are essential: a minimum-permission posture (the agent should connect to only the apps and data it genuinely needs), and a clear escalation path for edge cases the agent encounters. The most common failure pattern is an agent handling an edge case by making a plausible-but-wrong decision, and no one noticing until the downstream consequence has propagated.
training_optout: Same sub-processor chain as Zapier AI. Review both Zapier's terms and the underlying model provider's.
